1.d4 Nf6 2.c4 e6 3.Nc3 Bb4 4.f3 d5 5.a3.strategy: The only recapture. White gets the bishop pair and a pawn mass on c3, c4 and d4 with an advance of the e-pawn in mind; the doubled pawns and the loosened kingside are the price.
Attacks d4 at once, and with the d-pawn already hitting c4, both the c4 and d4 pawns come under pressure. White has to open the centre quickly, since only open lines give the bishops their scope.
